subject.title: fix(scripts): bound release upgrade baseline npm exec

question: Should release upgrade-baseline checks fail after 30 seconds when npm metadata is unavailable or slow, rather than continuing to wait?
rationale: The numeric timeout defines an operator-visible release automation failure policy; source review alone cannot establish the acceptable wait budget or diagnostic behavior.

options.title: Accept the 30-second budget
options.body: Land after redacted normal-path and timeout-path terminal evidence confirms the script fails predictably and preserves useful diagnostics.

options.title: Choose a different release budget
options.body: Set and document a different timeout if release infrastructure needs more than 30 seconds for healthy cold-cache npm metadata lookups.

recommendation.title: Accept the 30-second budget
recommendation.body: Land after redacted normal-path and timeout-path terminal evidence confirms the script fails predictably and preserves useful diagnostics.

likelyOwner.reason: No reliable current-main ownership attribution was retained for this release script.
